text: In response to concerns brought to my attention by members of the community, and at the request of Transportation Services, I am bringing forward a motion to Scarborough Community Council to install all-way compulsory stop controls at two locations in the Village Green Square community. Currently, the two subject locations on Village Green Square each have a yield sign on the north side of the intersection, all other traffic is free flowing at each of these intersections. The proposed all-way stop controls at these intersections is intended to ensure greater road user safety.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of the southerly east-west branch of Village Green Square and the westerly north-south branch of Village Green Square. 2. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of the southerly east-west branch of Village Green Square and the easterly north-south branch of Village Green Square.
